fields.statement: QA at 33cc5a571, scratch build run on a clone of the branch's repo: rhiza milestones --json gave 36 milestones, 6 finished; every done point's met flag and every milestone's state word matched the rules (checked with jq), and each done point's change sets were in its milestone's list. --view bogus and a short what-if ref failed cleanly with exit 2. But 2 of 11 runs died with 'fatal error: concurrent map writes' at internal/api/milestones.go:164 (an unlocked map write in the EachInFlight callback), and the same crash killed a daemon serving /roadmap.

QA at 33cc5a571, a scratch-build daemon (paused) on a two-project root: /p/rhiza/roadmap showed 30 open milestones each with 'Milestone · <state>', a segmented bar and legend (e.g. 13 landed, 2 accepted, 1 withdrawn), done points in a closed fold, groups Accepted waiting, Proposed, Landed, Drafts, with folds such as '8 more landed, 1 withdrawn', then the backlog and the umbrella, and '6 finished milestones' in one in-page fold with no links; every link stayed under /p/rhiza and no ID was rendered outside the model's own text. /p/other/roadmap (empty project) said Nothing is planned. Building now was not exercised (no runs in the clone). Loading the page once crashed the daemon via /api/milestones' concurrent map write, and renders took 25-51s.

QA at 33cc5a571, a scratch-build daemon: /p/rhiza/changes/<The web UI's frame> (landed) showed the title, state and intent, Facts Shipped 2026-11-13 22:07, Pull request PR #571 linking to GitHub and Serves, with no change set ID; 6 leaves with statement links, acceptance and 'Verified, has evidence'; decisions under Why, each link a 200 /p/rhiza/nodes/<id> page; and the Drafted/Proposed/Accepted/Landed history. The draft 'Approved designs' said 'No leaves yet'; unknown refs gave 404. The Run fact was not exercised (no runs in the clone).
